scope: Synthetic interface data semantics, grouped split isolation, source bindings, trace replay, and static/CPU trainer admission review; no claim about real radar facts or training effectiveness.
pairing: Each Chinese/English pair remains within one knowledge-instance group; both refer to the same record.
semantic_review_method: An audit-only lexical interpretation of each question first line independently extracts the named fictional entity, attribute and optional event/condition. All 200 derived record sets equal the declared reference. The six bilingual wording-frame pairs and field/event phrases were also read by the reviewer.
source_integrity: All source-entry fields, SHA256, pointer and evidence text match each queried record; every route contains 32 records, 3 entities and 7 attributes.
distractor_review: Each queried attribute exists on all three entities. Conditional/event questions retain competing same-entity records. Unknown power is an explicit null-valued record with two known-power entity distractors.

training_review.checks: Only three hash-admitted train files are opened; shared A/C token cache and paired seeds; exactly assistant actions supervised; context overflow rejected; integer-epoch actual sample/token accounting; final loss/gradient logs and LoRA parameter finite-value checks precede completion. P uses identical question exposure with its different serialized target length disclosed.

issues_resolved_before_admission: The first draft holdout plain subset lacked text targets; deterministic per-family subtype rotation now covers text and scalar in every split.
Source validation now compares all source-entry fields against records; altered value with unchanged citation is rejected.
Nominal trainer completion now rejects nonfinite training evidence or final trainable LoRA parameters.
limits: Synthetic numeric values are deliberately nonphysical and are not radar parameter evidence.
Only successful Find/query/finish trajectories are taught. This is interface adaptation, not additional recovery training.

Task families, field phrases, function/qualifier vocabulary and program structures are deliberately shared across splits; holdout separation does not establish unseen-reasoning or real-source generalization.
All targets are present records, including explicit unknown records; nonexistent-answer handling is not a supervised task in this corpus.
AI rewrite pairs share one intent and are not independent samples.
Trainer review used static inspection and CPU boundary tests; real tokenizer counts, remote library compatibility and actual GPU execution remain run-time checks.
This audit is not an experiment score or authorization for unbounded tuning. Root must bind this artifact and the final training/evaluation protocol before the single planned experiment.
